title: Leave a usable terminal after piped installation
when: Interrupting setup or resuming a suspended installer pipeline
need: The piped installer gives setup /dev/tty input. Ctrl-C quits setup; foreground resume after SIGTSTP restores its display. Mouse reporting and terminal settings must be restored before returning to the shell.
surface: Public shell installer and setup TUI
gap: Released-installer visual proof in iTerm is still required; isolated PTY tests are not a terminal-emulator screenshot.
review: POSIX regression executes real curl file URL | sh, foreground ownership, the setup driver and quit binding. Installation/download side effects are stubbed; interruption and suspend/resume verify mouse-mode cleanup and exact stty restoration.
